description: Source code for the RandomDecoderTest class, which provides methods for testing HTTP/2 decoding segments with various segmentations and validations.

classes.name: RandomDecoderTest
classes.description: A class for testing HTTP/2 decoding with randomized segmentations and validation.

methods.name: StopDecodeOnDone
methods.description: Returns whether decoding should stop when decoding is done.

methods.name: DecodeSegments
methods.description: Decodes segments from the input buffer with a specified segment size selector.

methods.name: DecodeAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes and validates the input buffer in multiple ways with different segmentations.

methods.name: SelectZeroAndOne
methods.description: Returns a segment size selector that alternates between zero and one.

methods.name: SelectRandom
methods.description: Returns a segment size selector that randomly chooses segment sizes.
